segments.text: Forty PDFs in the inbox by nine. You open each one, copy the vendor, the date, the total, and every line item.
Then you switch to the ERP. You remember which account code goes where, you fix the VAT, you hunt down the purchase order.
I'm Shayan from SpielOS. This ActivePieces flow does that whole loop from a single upload.
Quick note on the ledger you see here. It is an ActivePieces table standing in. In a live client build it is Xero, QuickBooks, or Sage. Same fields, just wired to your accounting tool.

It is reading the invoice now. Pulling the vendor, the line items and the amounts. Then coding each line to its right account. This normally takes about thirty seconds. I have sped it here.
There it is. Vendor, total, VAT. Every line coded to the right account, logged to the ledger and archived to Drive.
One upload. Full capture and coding. No manual typing. No copy paste into accounting software.
